options.name: a_actionitems
options.description: The actions to take when an ACL match is found.

options.name: a_errorfiles
options.description: The custom error files to use for this frontend.

options.name: a_extaddr
options.description: The external addresses assigned to this frontend.

options.name: advanced
options.description: Custom configuration to pass to this frontend.

options.name: advanced_bind
options.description: Custom value to pass behind each bind option.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: backend_serverpool
options.description: The default backend to use for this frontend.

options.name: client_timeout
options.description: The amount of time (in milliseconds) to wait for data from the client.

options.name: descr
options.description: The description for this HAProxy frontend.

options.name: dontlog_normal
options.description: Enables or disables only logging anomalous (not normal) connection.

options.name: dontlognull
options.description: Enables or disables logging connections with no data transferred.

options.name: forwardfor
options.description: Enables or disables the HTTP X-Forwarded-For header which contains the client's IP address.

options.name: ha_acls
options.description: The ACLs to apply to this frontend.

options.name: ha_certificates
options.description: The additional SSL/TLS certificates to use on this frontend.

options.name: httpclose
options.description: The `httpclose` option this frontend will operate.

options.name: log_detailed
options.description: Enables or disables more detailed logging.

options.name: log_separate_errors
options.description: Enables or disables changing the log level from info to err on potentially interesting info.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: max_connections
options.description: The maximum number of connections allowed by this frontend.

options.name: name
options.description: The unique name for this HAProxy frontend.

options.name: socket_stats
options.description: Enables or disables collecting and providing separate statistics for each socket.

options.name: ssloffloadcert
options.description: The default SSL/TLS certificate refid to use for this frontend.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: status
options.description: The activation status for this HAProxy frontend.

options.name: type
options.description: The processing type for this frontend.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
